title: GOV-0022: a research record's evidence_digest is not computed or checked (RSR-005 control 17)
problem:
## Observed
`schemas/research-record.schema.json` carries an `evidence_digest` field, but nothing computes or checks it — both shipped examples had it `null`. A claim or source can be edited and the record still validate, so `evidence_digest` is decorative: the acceptance-control "the record digest changes when material evidence changes" (control 17) is not enforced.

## Expected
`badf_gate.py research` computes the digest from the record's material evidence (sources, claims, contradictions, experiments) in canonical JSON and refuses a record whose `evidence_digest` does not match — computed, not asserted, like the two-plane verdict. Editing interpretation (findings, recommendation, disposition) does not change it.

## Evidence
`grep -n "evidence_digest" scripts/badf_gate.py` → absent on `main` at `e7ea929`; `python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('examples/research-record.json'))['evidence_digest'])"` → `None`.

## Unknowns
None. Controls 3 (baseline git-resolution, `repository-research` subskill territory) and 6 (source-digest staleness, needs a source fetch) need machinery beyond a record check and are separate later work; `badf-research` stays `DESIGNED` until all 18 pass.

## Proposed work package
`BADF-WP-0039` (RSR-005). `compute_research_evidence_digest` + control 17; both examples digest-bound; tests + mutation. C2. Brings 15 of 18 to enforced.
